routes.name: Best Route in Minnesota
routes.desc: Awesome route on a pinacle in the giant cave on the left. Rebolted with titanium.

routes.name: Cavepunk
routes.desc: Variation of 'Best Route in Minnesota'. Starts to the right for one bolt and then climbs right of the original bolt line. Grade not confirmed. Rebolted with titanium.

routes.name: Half-Pipe Dream
routes.desc: Climbs on the right side of the big cave. 5 titanium bolts, 5 slings.

routes.name: Hello Dali
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Goodbye Salvador', then moves to the left anchor.

routes.name: Goodbye Salvador
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Hello Dali', then straight up to the right anchor. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Nasty
routes.desc: Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb unless rebolted!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old rusty expansion bolts.
Climbing: Do not climb unless rebolted!

routes.name: Ribbed for Her Pleasure
routes.desc: Left of 'Short and Easy'. No bolts. Climb on toprope.

routes.name: Short and Easy
routes.desc: Warning Fixed Gear: Last bolt before anchor chopped, potential for ground fall Good lead for beginners. polished but very doable. 3 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Don't Grab the Krabi
routes.desc: Hard only on the crux, 3 moves. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Crazy Peninsula
routes.desc: Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb unless rebolted!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old rusty expansion bolts.
Climbing: Do not climb unless rebolted!

routes.name: Long Doo / Try
routes.desc: Shares the anchor with 'The Playground'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: The Playground
routes.desc: Shares anchors with 'Long Doo'. Bolts missing. Do not climb!
warnings: Climbing: Do not climb!

routes.name: Soley Action 1
routes.desc: Starts between the two caves a meter to the right of 'The Playground'. Shares the start with 'Mei Rue Arei', but has its own anchor. All slings. Be prepared to replace!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Be prepared to replace!

routes.name: Mei Rue Arei / Soley Action 2
routes.desc: Direct start from the cave or start as per 'Soley Action 1' or 'Humming Song' if it's too wet. Finishes on its own anchor a meter above and right of 'Soley Action 1'. 3 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: Humming Song (Left Variation)
routes.desc: Start on 'Humming Song' and go left after the second clip. Follow the slings and bolts until the last bolt and join the anchor of 'Humming Song'. There is a nice direct start clipping the first sling from the cave. If the sling is removed, consider doing the start as per 'Humming Song'.

routes.name: Humming Song
routes.desc: Climb on the corner and goes straight to the anchor at the right of the tree. Shares the start with 'Scorpion'. 3 titanium bolts, 3 slings.

routes.name: Scorpion
routes.desc: The rightmost line on the left side of the wall, located directly ahead of the approach trail. Shares the start with 'Humming Song'. 3 titanium bolts, 3 slings.
